user.title: The Green Finger
user.description: Connect to [OpenPlantbook]({url}) to look up species, care tips and pictures when you add a plant. Create a free account there, open its API key page and paste the client ID and secret. You can leave both empty and enter everything by hand.

reconfigure.title: OpenPlantbook credentials
reconfigure.description: Leave both empty to work without species lookup.

error.invalid_auth: OpenPlantbook rejected the client ID or secret.
error.rate_limited: OpenPlantbook is rate limiting requests. Try again in a minute.
error.both_required: Enter both the client ID and the secret, or leave both empty.

abort.single_instance_allowed: The Green Finger is already set up.

user.title: Find the species
user.description: Search OpenPlantbook by Latin name (for example *monstera deliciosa*). Leave empty to enter the plant by hand.

pick.title: Pick the species
pick.description: Watering, feeding, ranges and care tips are filled in from the species. You can change everything afterwards.

plant.title: Plant details
plant.description: The essentials are here; open the sections below for more. Everything can be changed later.

data_description.moisture_entity: Optional. Shows live moisture, temperature and battery on the card.
data_description.auto_watered: When the soil suddenly gets much wetter, the plant is marked as watered today.

more.name: More details
more.description: Spot in the room, your own picture, species and notes.

data_description.picture: Leave empty to use the species picture. Upload your own on the card, or paste an address.

ranges.name: Ideal ranges
ranges.description: Drive the green zone of the gauges and the dry / wet warnings.

nutrition.name: Fertiliser and soil
nutrition.description: The ideal N-P-K ratio and the soil mix this plant lives in.

data.soil_mix: Soil mix (one per line, e.g. 30% perlite)

schedule.title: Watering and feeding schedule
schedule.description: One period per line, for example `{example}`. Use `rest` instead of a number of days for a pause. Outside every period the plant rests.

error.invalid_auth: OpenPlantbook rejected the credentials. Update them in the integration's menu.
error.rate_limited: OpenPlantbook is rate limiting requests. Try again in a minute.
error.no_results: No species found, even by common name. Try the Latin name.
error.sensor_in_use: That sensor is already assigned to {plant}. Choose another sensor or remove it from that plant first.
error.invalid_soil_mix: Could not read the soil mix line "{line}". Use for example 30% perlite, and keep the total at 100% or less.
error.invalid_schedule: Could not read the line "{line}". Use for example 1 Mar - 30 Nov: every 10 days

not_loaded.message: The Green Finger is not set up.

rate_limited.message: OpenPlantbook is limiting requests right now. Try again in about {seconds} seconds; species you already looked up are cached.

invalid_auth.message: OpenPlantbook rejected the client ID or secret. Update them with Reconfigure on the integration page.

cannot_connect.message: Could not reach OpenPlantbook. Check the internet connection and try again.

sensor_in_use.message: The sensor {sensor} is already assigned to {plant}.

no_credentials.message: Add your OpenPlantbook credentials in the integration's menu to search for species.

invalid_schedule.message: Could not read the schedule line "{line}".

invalid_soil_mix.message: Could not read the soil mix line "{line}".

search_species.name: Search species
search_species.description: Search OpenPlantbook and return matching species with picture and ranges.

query.name: Search
query.description: Latin name or part of it, at least three letters.

get_species.name: Get species
get_species.description: Return the cached OpenPlantbook record and the suggested schedule for a species.

species.name: Species ID
species.description: OpenPlantbook plant ID, for example monstera deliciosa.

add_plant.name: Add plant
add_plant.description: Create a plant. Schedules default from the species when one is given.

water.name: Watering periods
water.description: List of [start_month, start_day, end_month, end_day, days] or text lines such as 1 Mar - 30 Nov: every 10 days.

npk.name: N-P-K
npk.description: [N, P, K] numbers of the ideal fertiliser.

soil_mix.name: Soil mix
soil_mix.description: Text lines such as 30% perlite, or a list of name and percent pairs.

auto_watered.name: Mark as watered automatically
auto_watered.description: Record a watering when the soil sensor jumps up.

update_plant.name: Update plant
update_plant.description: Change any detail of a plant. Only the fields you send are changed.

water.name: Watering periods
water.description: List of [start_month, start_day, end_month, end_day, days] or text lines.

npk.name: N-P-K
npk.description: [N, P, K] numbers of the ideal fertiliser.

soil_mix.name: Soil mix
soil_mix.description: Text lines such as 30% perlite, or a list of name and percent pairs.

auto_watered.name: Mark as watered automatically
auto_watered.description: Record a watering when the soil sensor jumps up.

remove_plant.name: Remove plant
remove_plant.description: Delete a plant and its entities.

water.name: Water
water.description: Record that a plant was watered.

fertilise.name: Fertilise
fertilise.description: Record that a plant was fertilised.

refresh_species.name: Refresh species data
refresh_species.description: Download the species record again from OpenPlantbook.

plant_id.name: Plant ID
plant_id.description: Subentry ID of one plant; leave empty for all.

postpone.name: Postpone
postpone.description: Move the next watering or feeding back by a number of days (they add up until it is recorded).
